spec.description: Incus Prometheus metrics. server_name via Prometheus relabeling.

spec.expr: avg by (server_name) (  (1 - sum by (server_name, cpu) (rate(incus_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",server_name=~"$server"}[5m]))  / clamp_min(sum by (server_name, cpu) (rate(incus_cpu_seconds_total{server_name=~"$server"}[5m])), 0.001)) * 100)

avg by (server_name) (  (1 - sum by (server_name, cpu) (rate(incus_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",server_name=~"$server"}[5m]))  / clamp_min(sum by (server_name, cpu) (rate(incus_cpu_seconds_total{server_name=~"$server"}[5m])), 0.001)) * 100)
avg by (server_name) (  (1 - sum by (server_name, cpu) (rate(incus_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m]))  / clamp_min(sum by (server_name, cpu) (rate(incus_cpu_seconds_total{}[5m])), 0.001)) * 100)

avg by (server_name) (  (1 - sum by (server_name, cpu) (rate(incus_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",server_name=~"$server"}[5m]))  / clamp_min(sum by (server_name, cpu) (rate(incus_cpu_seconds_total{server_name=~"$server"}[5m])), 0.001)) * 100)

avg by (server_name) (  (1 - sum by (server_name, cpu) (rate(incus_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",server_name=~".*"}[5m]))  / clamp_min(sum by (server_name, cpu) (rate(incus_cpu_seconds_total{server_name=~".*"}[5m])), 0.001)) * 100)
